Your requests stay on the device

Commands are understood on the phone itself, with no AI service and no cloud. Alarms, timers, the flashlight, volume, media, conversions, the world clock, apps, contacts and calculations never leave your phone. The wake word is heard by an offline listener on the phone. Web suggestions and instant answers send what you type to DuckDuckGo. Weather sends a city name, or your location rounded to about 1 km, to Open-Meteo. “What is…” questions are sent to Wikipedia. The name of an artist, song or album you ask Spotify to play is looked up on Wikidata, once. The optional “press play in Spotify” helper only looks at Spotify, for a few seconds after you ask. Currency conversions download the European Central Bank\'s daily rates; nothing is sent. Words you ask to define are sent to Wiktionary. Your calendar and call history are read on the phone and never leave it. Replies are spoken by the phone\'s own offline voice.
